thread:
Nora Kim: SilverLake (acct SLK-55) invoice INV-5231 $28,600 is 32 days past due. AM says they're asking for a billing deferral while they close their Series B.
Dante Alvarez: I spoke with their CFO yesterday. They're requesting a 60-day deferral and to keep services active. Said funding docs are in final review.
Rishi Kapoor: Our standard is a max 30-day deferral for credit-approved accounts. Do they have a payment history that supports extended terms?
Dante Alvarez: Good payer historically but two recent spikes in usage. They've been on a credit line for 6 months with no late payments prior to this.
Nora Kim: We could offer a one-time 45-day deferral conditional on: updated payment method + a signed deferral addendum + a $5k good-faith payment within 7 days. If they accept, put AR status to "deferred" and pause escalation.
LegalOps: We'll need to draft the deferral addendum. Clause should state that missing the $5k initial payment triggers immediate suspension and collection escalation. We can turn around a template in <24h.
Rishi Kapoor: Collections team OK with conditional deferral. Require AM to collect the $5k and attach proof. Also recommend placing a conservative throttle on embeddings to prevent surprise runaways (e.g., 150rps).
Dante Alvarez: I'll confirm with their CFO and push to get the $5k wired. I told them we'd draft the addendum and asked for signed copy within 5 business days.
CollectionsBot: Automated notice sent to billing@silverlake.io at 2024-07-12 09:20:01 with summary and deadline.
Nora Kim: If they refuse deferral, we proceed with service suspension after 48h final notice. Also prepare payment plan option: 3 monthly installments if they prefer.
Dante Alvarez: CFO replied: expects to approve the 45-day deferral, will attempt to wire the $5k by EOD tomorrow. Asked about auto-draft capability for the remainder.
Nora Kim: Acknowledged. Add note: enable ACH auto-draft once addendum signed and payment method updated. Collections, please pause dunning sequence pending confirmation.
CollectionsBot: Sequence paused for account SLK-55 by Nora Kim at 2024-07-12 10:05:27. Follow-up scheduled in 6 days.
Rishi Kapoor: Ledger note: if $5k received, apply to INV-5231 and mark partial-paid. If not received by deadline, resume sequence and notify Legal for escalation.
